::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** January 15th [1891]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell/15[^1]
:::

Dear Madam [Sir](people/person_1477.qmd)

Pray excuse the mistake  Certainly Jeannie is a mere caressing form of Jean, just as Annie is of Anne.  Both are only the Scottish form of Johanna, Jane or Joan

yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: With envelope addressed to The Revd M G Watkins/ Kentchurch Rectory/Hereford and postmarked Winchester 15 January 1891 and Pontrilas 16 January 1891.
